subscription_products.description: Products recommended for recurring auto-ship subscription (exactly 15 items)

slot_id.description: Slot ID from the original recommendations

autoship_eligible.description: Whether product is eligible for autoship/subscription

subscription_rationale.description: Detailed explanation of WHY this product should be a subscription, including consumption rate calculation, frequency reasoning, and pet-specific factors

estimated_frequency.description: Estimated subscription frequency (e.g., 'Every 4 weeks', 'Every 2 weeks', 'Every 6 weeks')

personalized_note.description: Warm, personalized note for the pet parent explaining why THIS product is perfect for THEIR pet. Use pet's name, reference specific characteristics, focus on benefits. Conversational and friendly tone.

one_time_products.description: Products recommended for one-time purchase (exactly 15 items)

slot_id.description: Slot ID from the original recommendations

autoship_eligible.description: Whether product is eligible for autoship/subscription

one_time_rationale.description: Detailed explanation of WHY this product should be a one-time purchase, including durability, seasonality, setup nature, or other factors

personalized_note.description: Warm, personalized note for the pet parent explaining why THIS product is perfect for THEIR pet. Use pet's name, reference specific characteristics, focus on benefits. Conversational and friendly tone.

overall_strategy.description: Brief but comprehensive explanation (2-4 sentences) of the subscription vs. one-time strategy for THIS specific pet at THIS journey stage. Address: why these subscriptions make sense, why these one-time purchases, and how order history/season/consumption patterns informed your decisions.
